topic: Exploring the 2-adic Metric: Where Infinite Sums Behave Differently
target_audience: Undergraduate mathematics students or advanced high school students

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Usual Notion of Convergence
lecture_lines: Standard distance measures physical gaps on a line.
A frog jumps, halving its distance to target.
The sum converges as jumps get smaller.

sections.title: Introducing the 2-adic Metric
lecture_lines: Higher powers of 2 mean smaller norms.
animations: Fade in title: 'Introducing the 2-adic Metric'. Color: #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Infinite Sums in the 2-adic World
lecture_lines: A series converges if terms shrink 2-adically.
The ultrametric inequality allows unique behavior.
animations: Fade in title: 'Infinite Sums in the 2-adic World'. Color: #FFFFFF.
Show total sum converging to -1. Color: #FFAA44. Flash text '-1'.
